acceptance.given: Stable and Candidate subjects are prepared for Matrix Case execution with their distinct fixtures and state.

oracle.expected: Each execution's evidence identifies both its Matrix Case and the executed subject.
forbidden: Execution evidence cannot be attributed to its Matrix Case or subject.
oracle.observable: The S2 selector's emitted execution-evidence records and assertions.

acceptance.then: Attributable evidence exists for all Matrix Case executions.
acceptance.when: Stable and Candidate subjects execute through the planned S2 Toolchain behavior test.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The S2 runtime behavior test must fail while emitted Matrix Case evidence omits its Matrix Case or executed-subject attribution.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Record Matrix Case and executed-subject attribution on evidence emitted for immutable Stable and Candidate executions with distinct fixtures and state.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; reverting removes the Toolchain evidence-attribution behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix Case executions without specified attribution transition to evidence records attributable to their Matrix Case and executed subject.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S2 test observes evidence for each exercised Matrix Case execution that identifies its Matrix Case and executed subject.

acceptance.given: Replay Matrix evaluation is run from the pinned SM-6 inputs with the frozen set of unaffected Matrix Cases and their distinct fixtures or state transitions available; the replay worker and case-evidence validator are invoked through the repository Toolchain entry point.

oracle.expected: For every unaffected Matrix Case, current evidence records an actual Stable-side and Candidate-side execution, the observed terminal behavior and diagnostic category, the case identity, fixture/state identity, command identity, and result identity; each observed behavior matches the frozen required behavior, and the aggregate marks all unaffected cases preserved only when every case satisfies those checks.
forbidden: A case is marked preserved when either subject was not executed or no current process receipt exists.
Case labels, unchanged hashes, copied output, or historical evidence are accepted as proof of preserved behavior.
A missing, stale, wrong-target, timeout, or infrastructure-failed case is silently counted as preserved.
oracle.observable: The generated Matrix evidence and validation result contain one attributable current execution receipt for each unaffected case and both subjects, with independently observed required behavior and a preservation verdict; deleting or falsifying any case receipt causes validation to reject preservation.

acceptance.then: The acceptance validator evaluates the complete current Matrix evidence after all unaffected cases have run and verifies per-case execution, identity, and behavior bindings before computing the aggregate preservation result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Mutate one unaffected Matrix Case evidence to omit its Stable or Candidate process execution while retaining its label and expected behavior; the runtime guard must observe the missing execution and reject preservation.
Replace a case's current execution receipt with unchanged package hashes or a copied prior result; the evidence validator must reject hash-only or copied proof of preserved behavior.
Bind an unaffected case receipt to a target, fixture, or state identity different from the frozen Matrix Case; validation must reject the preservation claim.

Execute an unaffected case through a deterministic path that returns a diagnostic category or terminal behavior different from its frozen required behavior; the runtime result must fail the preservation assertion.

affected_subjects: unaffected Matrix Case execution and evidence validation
slice_hint.behavior_change: Make SM-6 replay evaluation execute every unaffected Matrix Case for both Stable and Candidate subjects and bind each current receipt to the case, fixture/state, command, target, terminal behavior, and diagnostic category; aggregate preservation is true only when all such observations independently match the frozen required behavior.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay CLI and receipt schema compatibility; on rollback, prior Matrix evaluation behavior and terminal categories remain unchanged for already-supported cases while the new per-unaffected-case execution/evidence gate is removed atomically.

slice_hint.state_transition: For each frozen unaffected case: materialize isolated Stable and Candidate state, invoke the real replay command for both subjects, capture bounded current receipts, validate identity and required behavior, then compute the all-cases-preserved aggregate; any missing, mismatched, stale, or failed receipt transitions the aggregate to unsuccessful.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: PASS iff every unaffected Matrix Case has two current attributable execution receipts, each receipt matches its frozen case/fixture/state and required terminal behavior, all diagnostic categories are declared and valid, and no receipt is copied, hash-only, stale, wrong-target, timed-out, or infrastructure-failed; otherwise preservation is unsuccessful.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result succeeds for an input whose Validator Capability is independently evaluable.

oracle.expected: The replay result includes a Validator Capability verification outcome produced for that result, independently of other replay verifications.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result whose Validator Capability verification is inferred from another verification.
oracle.observable: The successful replay result's per-result Validator Capability verification outcome.

acceptance.then: The successful Replay Result carries its own Validator Capability verification outcome.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the S24 replay behavior test with a successful replay whose Validator Capability outcome is omitted or borrowed; the runtime assertion must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require each successful replay result to independently verify and expose its Validator Capability outcome.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore prior replay-result verification handling without changing the capability descriptor schema.

slice_hint.state_transition: successful replay without independent capability verification -> successful replay with a per-result independent capability outcome
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S24 selector rejects a successful replay that lacks its own Validator Capability verification.

acceptance.given: A valid target package is supplied with a validator capability substituted for the repository-trusted capability, while all non-substitution inputs remain valid.

oracle.expected: The validator-capability selection rejects the substituted capability with a nonzero result and emits no trusted validation receipt.
forbidden: Proceeding with a substituted validator capability.
Treating an undeclared validator as the trusted capability.
A trusted pass receipt for the substituted capability.
oracle.observable: The targeted pytest case invokes the replay entrypoint with the substitution fixture and observes the nonzero rejection plus absence of a trusted result.

acceptance.then: The substituted validator capability is rejected without a trusted result.
acceptance.when: When a validator capability other than the required capability is supplied or selected.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the existing replay unit selector with an isolated substituted-capability fixture and require the entrypoint to fail closed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind validator selection to the repository-trusted capability identity and reject an invocation whose supplied capability resolves to an undeclared substitute before validation can produce a trusted result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or receipt-schema migration is introduced; rollback restores the prior capability-selection behavior in the replay entrypoint.

slice_hint.state_transition: A supplied or selected undeclared validator capability transitions from candidate selection to fail-closed rejection, with no trusted validation result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted unit selector demonstrates that substituting the validator capability yields a nonzero rejection and no trusted validation receipt.
